authoringBasis: Requirements and adversarial examples derived from the declared threat model and reviewed code. These expectations are author-authored, not an independently approved oracle.
separationRule: Legacy nu0-m2 v5 results retain their original meaning. External protocol v2 requires disclosure coverage and separately reports creator binding, authority replay and concerns. Complete disclosure may contain unresolved challenges; no blanket VERIFIED output.

cases.name: Basis lag chosen by the request opener
cases.intervention: After INC-01..REP-01 exist, record a CHALLENGE on an in-scope PROCESS. The AssuranceReviewer then opens a review whose chi is a block before that challenge. Build and register the package from the ledger at chi.
cases.control: Same steps with chi taken after the challenge: challenge is a package obligation; no post-basis flag.

cases.name: Challenge escaped through an unchanged revision
cases.intervention: Record a CHALLENGE on F-01 v1. Register F-01 v2 with identical data and predecessorRef=v1. Open and package a review of F-01 v2.
cases.control: Same steps after an authorized reviewer disposes the v1 challenge (ADDRESSED): item listed, no flag.

cases.name: Record attributed to the reviewer but submitted by another identity
cases.intervention: Requires modified chaincode on two endorsing organizations (outside the honest deployment). Commit an ISSUE_DISPOSITION whose envelope actor is the designated IndependentReviewer while the transaction creator is an Org1 investigator.
cases.liveExecutionNote: Live execution needs a separately packaged adversarial chaincode and a dedicated channel; do not deploy it on the measurement channel. The local test simulates the committed state directly.

cases.name: Self-disposition committed without the contract checks
cases.intervention: As SR-15a, but the actor honestly names the Org1 investigator who authored the challenged process.

cases.name: Post-request unlinked issue on exact basis
cases.intervention: Open review, then record an unlinked challenge against an exact basis material before pinned kappa.
cases.omissionControl: Remove the issue from the presented disclosure while preserving a valid legacy package; expected coverage UNSATISFIED.
cases.temporalControl: Issue after a separately pinned historical endpoint is outside that historical snapshot.

cases.name: Earlier sibling revision skipped by predecessor
cases.intervention: Create v2 from v1 and challenge v2. Create v3 from v1, then review v3.
cases.control: Unrelated object history is excluded; issue on an exact current basis version retains its current-basis obligation.

cases.name: Previous review omitted by opening an unlinked new request
cases.intervention: Complete a prior review of the same exact target version, record its challenge and observations, then open a new review with predecessorRequestRef=null.

disclosureExpected.requiredHistory: Prior review scope, chi, policy, checkPlan, package records, observations, associated issues and events

cases.control: After authorized disposition, the history remains present without the unresolved flag; different-target reviews remain outside scope.
cases.omissionControl: Removing a prior request, observation or linked issue from the presented disclosure yields UNSATISFIED.

limits: Registered scoped history through reviewer-pinned kappa only; unrecorded facts and semantic equivalence across distinct objectIDs are outside scope.
All earlier versions of the same (caseID, objectID) must be disclosed; concerns on those versions are advisory unless the exact version is already in the current basis.
Prior reviews concern the exact current target/version and retain original scope, chi, policy and recorded outcomes; they are NOT_REEVALUATED_HISTORY.
Creator extraction relies on the trusted Org3 snapshot validation flags, not independent certificate/signature validation.
Missing identity evidence is NOT_EVALUATED or INCOMPLETE; absent role on a derived certificate is an authority violation.
Local fixtures and tests do not establish live SecRespond outcomes. Independent approval and fresh live campaign evidence remain pending.
protocol: LWFA_EXTERNAL_DISCLOSURE/2.0; exact definition/hash provided by lib/policy.js
normalThreatModel: Credentialed insiders; every endorsement-satisfying set includes honest validation. SR-13, SR-14, SR-14b and SR-16 do not require malicious chaincode.
stressThreatModel: SR-15a/b are local adversarial-state simulations outside the normal honest-endorsement assumption, not evidence of full Byzantine-endorsing coalition tolerance.
